title: A Judge-free LLM Open-ended Generation Benchmark Based on the Distributional Hypothesis
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical evaluation framework for LLM generation quality using n-gram statistics and rule-based filters. Its primary metrics are Fluency, Truthfulness (in the sense of factuality/alignment with human distribution), and Helpfulness (defined by keyword presence). It does not contain any specific component evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
